provenance: The complete printed line.gd continues the actual tested Coordinates output by exact declared edits. The existing point, shape construction and LOCAL/WORLD readout remain; a duplicate endpoint and live distance are added. The supplied renderer is printed in full, unchanged, and bound to this new native report.

brief.bring: The tested Coordinates point.gd with its point, surface, collider and LOCAL/WORLD readout.
brief.make: Two held endpoints, a live segment, and the distance between them.
brief.given: Configured XR hands, a unit-scale study, and the complete supplied line_skin.gd renderer.
brief.build: Keep point and readout; duplicate the point once; convert both ends into the study frame; subtract, measure, and update the same visible segment each frame.
brief.check: Either endpoint moves; both readings and distance follow; release stays; coincident endpoints hide the segment; pairs can be parallel, +, X or separated in depth.
brief.later: Trace stores positions in order. Grid will reuse points and relations without a pickup body at every position.

carry: A line study with two pickable endpoints, a live segment, the original coordinate readout and a distance reading. Pair exercises reuse this same line.
nextStatus: Trace continues this exact script by keeping the original held point and recording accepted local positions. Grid remains planned.
